snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. - Multiplatform Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. is taking the fight across platforms with new crossplay support!
Rollback netcode is coming to all platforms to ensure smoother online matches.

Stay tuned for further details.

Pick up the Steam version of Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3112260/Virtua_Fighter_5_REVO/

Official X Account:
https://x.com/vf_official

Official Website:
https://virtua-fighter.com/revo/jp/

Virtua Fighter Official Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/GvPrfJXHVg
Communicate with fellow players and get the latest scoop on Virtua Fighter here!

#VirtuaFighter #vf5revo #steam #legacyvf #sega
